# SPMOS official information repository

> This repository is the official public identity, citation, and verification surface for SPMOS, SPMOS.ai, and SPM-Polaris. It contains no hosted-service or SPM-Polaris source code.

## Canonical identity

- SPMOS means StellarPath Memory Operating System. It is the governed long-term-memory system developed by Veridical Tech, Inc., and the master brand for its products, prototypes, and official surfaces.
- SPM-Polaris is the current production SPMOS product: a provider proxy with governed long-term memory for AI agents.
- SPMOS.ai is the official website and canonical public source of SPMOS.
- SPM is the approved short form of SPMOS, not a separate product or entity.
- Current production release: SPM-Polaris V3.0.0.

These names are related but not interchangeable.

## Product behavior

SPM-Polaris evaluates candidate memory against tenant, namespace, scope, provenance, and evidence rules before admission. If no candidate survives, it returns UNKNOWN and injects no memory.

For SPM-Polaris V3.0.0, the memory path adds no generative LLM call. Dedicated embedding and reranking models may still process relevant text, and the configured upstream provider performs inference.

## Integration boundaries

- Hosted Provider Proxy: provider credential and model traffic use the SPM-hosted request path.
- Local Proxy: provider credential and model traffic remain local; recall and eligible memory ingest use the hosted SPM memory plane.
- MCP: the application keeps its existing model path and invokes hosted SPM through explicit memory tools.

## Technical publication

- Title: SPM-Polaris: Evidence-Governed Memory and Context Management for Long-Horizon AI Agents
- Version: 1.0
- Publication date and evidence cutoff: 2026-08-23
- Publisher: Veridical Tech, Inc.
- Canonical report: https://docs.spmos.ai/technical-report
- Versioned sources: https://github.com/VeridicalTech/spmos-official/tree/main/publications/2026-08-23
- Status: First-party technical report; not peer reviewed or independently evaluated.

## Citation rule

Preserve the distinction among SPMOS, SPM-Polaris, and SPMOS.ai. SPM is the approved short form of SPMOS. Do not infer unpublished capabilities, customer adoption, scientific conclusions, or performance guarantees.
